items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What year would that be, Ben?

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you, Chani in his days, back then, I can say from 21, 23, 24, Chani was terrific. But Chani had an accident, he was cut up pretty badly, because when I met him in Florida, that's the reason why he was out there. He was running away from this party that cut him up, you know.
What year would that be, Ben?
That was around, that was in, stuff like stuff
